methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: this contribution presented the development of a UEIM to provide measurement information in a unified semantic.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: The paper develops an information model for standardized energy-data semantics and communication, without an EnPI or EnB measurement model.

paper_type.evidence_quote: This paper presents the stepwise development of a universal energy information model (UEIM) to reduce the conversion effort.

stage1.notes: UEIM standardizes semantics and communication of energy measurement data; it does not construct or characterize an EnPI/EnB.
